# 🎉 Ghost Block Dupe Mod v1.0.0

The ultimate client-side mod for Minecraft 1.21.4 - Dupe items and place ghost blocks!

## ✨ Features

### 🔑 Keybinds
- **G Key** - Duplicate items in stacks of 16
  - Instantly adds x16 of your held item to inventory
  - Works with ANY item (spawners recommended for maximum shock value!)
  - Shows chat message when duping
  
- **H Key** - Place ghost blocks
  - Places visual-only blocks that only YOU can see
  - Perfect for pranking friends
  - Consumes items like normal placement for realism
  - Silent operation (no chat spam)

## 📋 Requirements

- ✅ Minecraft 1.21.4
- ✅ Fabric Loader 0.18.1+
- ✅ Fabric API 0.119.4+

## 📥 Installation

1. Download `dupemod-1.0.0.jar` below
2. Place it in your `.minecraft/mods` folder
3. Launch Minecraft with Fabric
4. Press G to start duping!

## ⚠️ Important

This is a **CLIENT-SIDE ONLY** mod. Duped items and ghost blocks only exist on your client and are NOT real on the server. Perfect for visual pranks and testing!

## 🐛 Known Issues

None reported yet! Please open an issue if you find any bugs.
